spellbook.finance/limitations: A configured eBay base-price trial is a seller-selected fixed equal-probability assignment using the two explicit multipliers; it is not an adaptive learner or a claim of improved profit.
A saved profile read does not prove a marketplace is using it or trigger repricing.
Pins contain only channel facts the server proved.

description: Read one seller pricing profile's approved multiplier, floor, dollar offset, ordinary value bands, channel overrides, and any configured fixed eBay base-price trial, then report active state and channel pin facts. Call it before an update or activation.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

profileId.description: The exact saved pricing profile id from a prior pricing profile read. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the seller selected. The caller must own it. Required.

name: spellbook_pricing_profile_get
